cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: Ask Around the Missing Detail
cards.instruction: Find one hidden fact by asking about everything surrounding it and never naming it directly.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Next time, tell me to leave dinner in the oven. How late did you eat with your visitor?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Ten. And you don't get to interview me about my date.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Fine. I'll leave you both alone. Should I keep a second portion warm on Fridays?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Only if the last bus is late again.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Which route? I'll check it before I turn the oven off.
